title: Anna Boberg's Painting Rig
content: Swedish artistAnna Boberg(1864-1935) was a self-taught innovator, and she developed an unusual design for a plein-air easel.Anna BobergThe painting was held in a frame that attached to a waist band and propped up against her right leg.In addition to her winter landscapes, Boberg was known for her writing and herArt-Nouveau ceramics.-----Anna Bobergon WikipediaThanks Ricky Mujica and Gregory Dunham
